title: free-for-creators field notes
description: Schema for data/experiences/notes.json — first-hand write-ups by creators about using a listed resource. Editor aid; authoritative validation lives in scripts/experiences.py.

id.description: Stable slug, unique across the store; the site uses it as the card anchor (#note-<id>).

entry_url.description: The verbatim url of the entry this note is about — must equal an entry's url in data/*.json, exactly as written.

author.description: GitHub handle of the creator who wrote it.

lang.description: Language the note is written in. The other language is not translated — the card is shown as written.

date.description: The day the experience happened; not in the future.

body.description: A single paragraph: what you made, what the license turned out to be in practice, what went wrong. No line breaks.

evidence.description: The public thread this note came from. Required so every published note is reviewable and revertible.

reviewed_by.description: Maintainer who read the thread and let the note onto the site.
